data_fields.name: hit_tick_count
data_fields.donor_constant: max(loser HP before hit, damage taken by winner)

best_idea: Present a hit as a queued HP drain on copies of the two units, computed from the start and end HP the authority already sent, so the presentation never writes the ledger and the drain takes a fixed number of ticks.
decision_why: Head-only queue, presentation over authority and integer tick drain are the shape the Pit needs for hit display with up to three attackers on one defender; wall-clock timing and the blocking real-HP writes are rejected.
acceptance: With three attackers, each hit plays as a queued drain on a copy of the defender (tick 10 ms, tick count max(defender HP before, damage dealt)); server final HP is the ledger value; second hit waits for the first; drawn HP never rises and the kill is applied once from the server record.
